(2) false_eigenvalue_third.lean:114 changes smaller_eigenvalue_exceeds_third (Ledger.lean:114) from `58 * 9 < 23 ^ 2` to `58 * 9 < 22 ^ 2`. items.classification_reason: Gate-probe fixtures, not mathematical claims of the project. receipt/custom_imported.lean:2-4 declares `axiom hiddenPremise : False` and derives `injected : False` from it. receipt/sorry.lean:2 states `injected : False` by `sorry`. receipt/native.lean:2 states `(2 : Nat) + 2 = 4` by `native_decide`.
